structure: Part 3, Transport, arrival and documents. Read in full: e2e/transport-and-arrival.fit.spec.js (373 lines, 13 tests in 5 describes: arrival details 2, transit countries 1, transporter details 4, germinal transporter details 1, add a transporter 5), e2e/documents.fit.spec.js (144 lines, 7 tests in 2 describes: upload documents 6, upload documents from the hub 1), and the shared helpers e2e/support/journey.js (283 lines) and e2e/support/fixtures.js (48 lines). Pages covered, all under the /design-release-2.1 mount: /arrival-details, /transit-countries (and its guard), /transporter (list, selected, change, remove, germinal variant), the legacy /transport-details redirect, /transporter/add, /transporter/add/private (postcode, address results, details, manual entry, cancel), /transporter/add/commercial (authorisation number, Northern Ireland postcode, manual entry), /upload-documents (guidance, fields, validation, listing, virus status), /upload-documents/<id>/delete, and /upload-documents?from=hub. Shared journey.js assertions these tests call are claimed once each (error summary title, inline error, back link, heading, date format, start of a notification, arrival answers). fixtures.js only records visited pages for the trace index and shows no prototype behaviour.

claims.statement: The upload documents guidance names other documents to upload, including 'import licences or authorisations' and 'commercial documents or invoices'.
claims.quote:
await expect(main).toContainText('import licences or authorisations')
    await expect(main).toContainText('commercial documents or invoices')
claims.note: Whether these are list items, and whether the list has more, is not asserted.

claims.statement: The upload documents page has 'Check which additional documents you must upload', with one link to the GOV.UK guidance at https://www.gov.uk/guidance/import-of-products-animals-food-and-feed-system.
claims.quote:
await expect(main).toContainText('Check which additional documents you must upload')
    await expect(main.locator('a[href^="https://www.gov.uk/guidance/import-of-products-animals-food-and-feed-system"]')).toHaveCount(1)

claims.statement: The document fields sit under the text 'File upload'.
claims.quote: await expect(main).toContainText('File upload')
claims.note: Read as a sub-heading; only its presence in main is asserted.

claims.statement: The upload documents page has a field labelled 'Document reference'.
claims.quote: await expect(page.getByLabel('Document reference')).toBeVisible()

claims.statement: The document type is a select with, in order: 'Select one', 'Intra Trade Animal Health Certificate (ITAHC)', 'Veterinary health certificate', 'Air waybill', 'Import permit', 'Letter of authority (Directive 2008/61/EC)', 'Commercial invoice', 'Sea waybill', 'Rail waybill', 'Bill of lading', 'Catch certificate', 'Laboratory sampling results for aflatoxin (Reg 2019/1793)', 'Journey log', 'Other'.
claims.quote: await expect(page.locator('#document-type option')).toHaveText(DOCUMENT_TYPES)
claims.note: Option values seen: 'itahc' and 'air-waybill'.

claims.statement: The upload documents page has a date field labelled 'Date of issue', taking d/m/yyyy.
claims.quote: await expect(page.getByLabel('Date of issue')).toBeVisible()

claims.statement: The file upload rules say files must be smaller than 50MB.
claims.quote: 'files that are smaller than 50MB'
claims.note: Only the copy is asserted; no test uploads an oversize file.

claims.statement: The file upload rules say files must be PDF, DOC, DOCX, JPEG, JPG, PNG, XLS or XLSX.
claims.quote: 'PDF, DOC, DOCX, JPEG, JPG, PNG, XLS or XLSX'
claims.note: Only the copy is asserted; no test uploads a disallowed type.

claims.statement: The file upload rules allow up to a maximum of 15 files.
claims.quote: 'up to a maximum of 15 files'
claims.note: Only the copy is asserted.

claims.statement: The file upload rules say 'ZIP files are not allowed for security reasons'.
claims.quote: 'ZIP files are not allowed for security reasons'
claims.note: Only the copy is asserted.

claims.statement: Before a file is chosen, the upload field shows 'No file chosen'.
claims.quote: await expect(main).toContainText('No file chosen')

claims.statement: The upload documents page has a 'Save and add another' button.
claims.quote: await expect(main.getByRole('button', { name: 'Save and add another' })).toBeVisible()

claims.statement: The upload documents back link goes to the notification hub.
claims.quote: await expectBackLink(page, url('/notification-hub'))

claims.statement: 'Save and add another' with nothing entered is refused with, in order: 'Enter a document reference', 'Select a document type', 'Enter a date of issue', 'Upload a document'.
claims.quote: await expectErrorSummary(page, ['Enter a document reference', 'Select a document type', 'Enter a date of issue', 'Upload a document'])

claims.statement: A date of issue that is not a real date, such as 30/2/2026, is refused with 'Enter a real date'.
claims.quote:
await fillDate(page, '#date-of-issue', '30/2/2026')
    await clickAction(page, 'add-another')
    await expectErrorSummary(page, ['Enter a real date', 'Upload a document'])

claims.statement: Uploads are optional, but once a document type is chosen every document field must be completed: continuing with only a type chosen keeps the user on the page with 'Enter a document reference', 'Enter a date of issue' and 'Upload a document'.
claims.quote:
// Section 4 of the DR2.1 task list: upload documents. Uploads are optional, but
// once a document type is chosen every document field must be completed.

claims.statement: Continuing from upload documents with nothing chosen goes on to the roles and addresses page.
claims.quote:
await saveAndContinue(page)
    await expect(page).toHaveURL(urlFor('/roles-and-addresses'))

claims.statement: Choosing a file shows its name on the page, such as 'itahc.pdf'.
claims.quote: await expect(page.locator('main')).toContainText('itahc.pdf')
claims.note: mechanism: the chosen file name is written to a hidden attachmentFileName field (journey.js:221).

claims.statement: A complete document saved with 'Save and add another' is listed in a table with the columns 'Document reference', 'Document type', 'Date of issue', 'Status' and 'Action'.
claims.quote: await expect(table.locator('thead th')).toHaveText(['Document reference', 'Document type', 'Date of issue', 'Status', 'Action'])

claims.statement: A listed document shows its reference, its document type by name (such as 'Intra Trade Animal Health Certificate (ITAHC)') and its date of issue as d/m/yyyy.
claims.quote:
await expect(table.locator('tbody tr').first()).toContainText('ITAHC-001')
    await expect(table.locator('tbody tr').first()).toContainText('Intra Trade Animal Health Certificate (ITAHC)')
    await expect(table.locator('tbody tr').first()).toContainText(dateFromToday(-2))

claims.statement: A newly listed document has the status 'Scanning for virus'.
claims.quote: await expect(table.locator('.app-upload-documents-table__status')).toHaveText('Scanning for virus')

claims.statement: Under the design release mount, a document's status never moves on from 'Scanning for virus', because the simulated virus check posts to the unprefixed route and reads the other release's session.
claims.note: mechanism: a prototype simulation of the virus check. The status the scan moves to is not shown under this mount, so what follows 'Scanning for virus' is unproven.

claims.statement: Each listed document has a 'Remove' link that opens a confirmation page at /design-release-2.1/upload-documents/<document id>/delete.
claims.quote: await expect(page).toHaveURL(/\/design-release-2\.1\/upload-documents\/[^/]+\/delete$/)

claims.statement: The delete document page title is 'Delete this document? - Import notification service - GOV.UK' and its heading 'Delete this document?'.
claims.quote:
await expect(page).toHaveTitle('Delete this document? - Import notification service - GOV.UK')
      await expectHeading(page, 'Delete this document?')

claims.statement: The delete document page has the inset text 'This will remove the document from this notification.'
claims.quote: await expect(main.locator('.govuk-inset-text')).toHaveText('This will remove the document from this notification.')

claims.statement: The delete document page summarises the document as 'Document reference', 'Document type', 'Date of issue' and 'File', with the file name.
claims.quote: await expect(main.locator('.govuk-summary-list__key')).toHaveText(['Document reference', 'Document type', 'Date of issue', 'File'])

claims.statement: The delete document page warns 'This action cannot be undone.'
claims.quote: await expect(main).toContainText('This action cannot be undone.')

claims.statement: The delete document page back link goes to upload documents.
claims.quote: await expectBackLink(page, url('/upload-documents'))

claims.statement: 'No, cancel' on the delete document page returns to upload documents with the document still listed.
claims.quote:
await main.getByRole('link', { name: 'No, cancel' }).click()
      await expect(page).toHaveURL(urlFor('/upload-documents'))
      await expect(table.locator('tbody tr')).toHaveCount(1)

claims.statement: 'Yes, delete' on the delete document page removes the document and returns to upload documents; with no documents left, the table is not shown.
claims.quote:
await page.locator('main').getByRole('button', { name: 'Yes, delete' }).click()
      await expect(page).toHaveURL(urlFor('/upload-documents'))
      await expect(page.locator('table.app-upload-documents-table')).toHaveCount(0)

claims.statement: The notification hub has an 'Upload documents' link that opens /design-release-2.1/upload-documents?from=hub, and the page carries that it came from the hub.
claims.quote:
await page.locator('main').getByRole('link', { name: 'Upload documents' }).click()
    await expect(page).toHaveURL(url('/upload-documents?from=hub').replace(/\./g, '.'))
    await expect(page.locator('input[name="from"][value="hub"]')).toHaveCount(1)
claims.note: mechanism: a hidden from=hub field.

claims.statement: Continuing from upload documents opened from the hub returns to the notification hub instead of the next page.
claims.quote:
await saveAndContinue(page)
    await expect(page).toHaveURL(urlFor('/notification-hub'))
claims.note: The test title calls this 'save and return to overview', but drives the continue action, not the hub action.

claims.statement: The specs prove no limit on how many documents are listed, and no refusal of a file by size, type or count.
claims.note: Only the rules copy is asserted (claims 111-114).

claims.statement: Every error summary on these pages is titled 'There is a problem' and lists its messages as links, in order.
claims.quote: await expect(summary.locator('.govuk-error-summary__title')).toHaveText('There is a problem')

claims.statement: Every page title in this part follows '<page> - Import notification service - GOV.UK'.
claims.quote: 'Arrival details - Import notification service - GOV.UK'
claims.note: Read from every title asserted in this part.

claims.statement: The design release pages are served under the /design-release-2.1 path prefix, mirroring the root route table.

// Design Release 2.1 is a mirror mount of the root route table.
const BASE = '/design-release-2.1'

claims.statement: Starting a notification at /design-release-2.1/create-notification redirects to the notification type page, and choosing live animals and continuing goes to the origin of the import page.

  await expect(page).toHaveURL(urlFor('/notification-type'))
